name: Kochi Sayuri
source:
She is a faithful handmaid fully devoted to her young mistress. . She has a quiet demeanor and gives a reserved impression.

She has never been with a man until now, but this is a reminder to herself that she must not neglect the young mistress by being distracted by a man.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_134.html#character]official site[/url]]
